title: Duplicate exception 'rbd.ImageHasSnapshots' — second except clause unreachable
detail: In `_cleanup_vol`, the first `except rbd.ImageHasSnapshots:` catches and handles the snapshot case. The second `except (rbd.ImageBusy, rbd.ImageHasSnapshots):` then has a duplicate entry for `ImageHasSnapshots` that can never be triggered, because the first clause already consumed it. As written, a retry with `ImageHasSnapshots` will only remove the snapshot but will never decrement `retryctx['retries']` or log the warning — making the retry logic incorrect. Remove `rbd.ImageHasSnapshots` from the second except clause.

title: 3 raise statements missing exception chaining
detail: At lines 273, 302, and 433, exceptions are raised inside except blocks without `from exc`. The original traceback context is lost, making it harder to diagnose RBD failures. Add `from exc` to preserve the root cause.
